data.name: Triveni
data.gender_notes: Triveni is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Triveni is a name of divine significance in Hindu mythology, representing the confluence of three sacred rivers - Ganga, Yamuna, and Saraswati. It symbolizes the union of the physical and spiritual worlds, purification, and the attainment of moksha. The name Triveni carries the meaning “Confluence of three rivers” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Triveni usually hope their child will grow to embody confluence of three rivers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the union of the physical and spiritual worlds
data.etymology: Triveni belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Confluence of three rivers.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Triveni total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

vedic_reference.note: The name Triveni is derived from the three sacred rivers - the Ganga, Yamuna, and the Saraswati. In Hindu mythology, Triveni is considered to be the place where these three rivers converge. It is also believed that taking a dip in the Triveni River absolves one of all their sins.

historical_references.reference: The legend of Triveni is associated with the three rivers, the Saraswati, the Yamuna, and the Ganges, which are believed to meet at this place. This sacred confluence is considered to be a pilgrimage site for Hindus, and is believed to offer moksha (liberation) to those who bathe in it.
historical_references.time_period: Ancient India, possibly dating back to the Vedic period.

historical_references.reference: The name 'Triveni' is derived from the three rivers that meet here- Triveni means 'three rivers' in Sanskrit. The site of the Triveni Sangam is located in Allahabad, Uttar Pradesh, India.

The name is now associated with three distinct platforms that cater to spiritualism, pilgrimage, and wellness trends. The Triveni Mela (Virtual), for instance, is an annual spiritual and cultural event that brings together renowned spiritual leaders, musicians, and artists from all over the world, creating a unique and immersive digital experience. Similarly, the Triveni Bridge (Digital) is a popular online platform designed to facilitate the spiritual journey of individuals by offering a range of services, including online puja, astrology consultations, and spiritual guidance. Lastly, the Triveni Seva Mission (Nonprofit) is a charitable organization that focuses on providing education, healthcare, and various other essential services to underserved communities, particularly in rural areas. The modern context of Triveni thus encompasses not only spiritual growth but also social impact, reflecting the evolving nature of the name and its relevance to contemporary society.
